meta.description: Opcional: canal Telegram. Desabilitado por padrão em channel_settings. Respeita channel_rules (ML bloqueado).

parameters.query:
SELECT p.* FROM products p
JOIN channel_settings s ON s.channel = 'telegram' AND s.enabled = TRUE
WHERE p.ai_publishable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM channel_rules r
    WHERE r.source = p.source AND r.channel = 'telegram' AND r.allowed = TRUE
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM publications pub
    WHERE pub.product_id = p.id AND pub.channel = 'telegram'
      AND pub.status = 'published' AND pub.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  )
ORDER BY p.opportunity_score DESC LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO publications (product_id, channel, content, affiliate_url, status, external_id, published_at)
VALUES ($1, 'telegram', $2, $3, 'published', $4, NOW());
